text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ

translations.asad: CONSIDER the heavens and that which comes in the night!
translations.sahih: By the sky and the night comer -

translations.asad: And what could make thee conceive what it is that comes in the night?
translations.sahih: And what can make you know what is the night comer?

translations.asad: It is the star that pierces through [life's] darkness:

text.arabic: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌۭ

translations.asad: [for] no human being has ever been left unguarded.
translations.sahih: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.

translations.asad: LET MAN, then, observe out of what he has been created:
translations.sahih: So let man observe from what he was created.

translations.asad: he has been created out of a seminal fluid
translations.sahih: He was created from a fluid, ejected,

translations.asad: issuing from between the loins [of man] and the pelvic arch [of woman].
translations.sahih: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.

translations.asad: Now, verily, He [who thus creates man in the first instance] is well able to bring him back [to life]
translations.sahih: Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able.

translations.asad: on the Day when all secrets will be laid bare,
translations.sahih: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,

text.arabic: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍۢ وَلَا نَاصِرٍۢ

translations.asad: and [man] will have neither strength nor helper!
translations.sahih: Then man will have no power or any helper.

translations.asad: and the earth, bursting forth with plants!
translations.sahih: And [by] the earth which cracks open,

translations.asad: BEHOLD, this [divine writ] is indeed a word that between truth and falsehood,
translations.sahih: Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement,

translations.asad: Behold, they [who refuse to accept it] devise many a false argument [to disprove its truth];
translations.sahih: Indeed, they are planning a plan,

translations.asad: but I shall bring all their scheming to nought.
translations.sahih: But I am planning a plan.

translations.asad: Let, then, the deniers of the truth have their will: let them have their will for a little while.
translations.sahih: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
